command_deck.name: Command Deck
command_deck.description: The high-tech nerve center of the station. Views of the gas giant below are visible through reinforced windows. The hum of life support systems fills the air.

life_support_console.name: Life Support Console
life_support_console.description: Controls oxygen routing, scrubbing, and emergency pressure balancing.

mess_hall.name: Mess Hall
mess_hall.description: The social hub of the station. A large circular table dominates the center, surrounded by benches. The smell of recycled coffee lingers in the air.

hydroponics_bay.name: Hydroponics Bay
hydroponics_bay.description: Densely packed with oxygen-producing ferns and nutrient vats. It's humid and smells of wet earth. Rows of genetically modified crops stretch into the distance.

oxygen_generator.name: Oxygen Generator
oxygen_generator.description: A biological oxygen processing rig that keeps breathable air cycling through the station.

elevator_bay.name: Elevator Bay
elevator_bay.description: A circular platform that connects all levels of the station. The glass walls offer a vertigo-inducing view down the central shaft.

engineering.name: Engineering
engineering.description: The heart of the station's power systems. Massive reactors pulse with blue light, and the constant thrum of energy conversion vibrates through the floor.

reactor_control.name: Reactor Control Array
reactor_control.description: Monitors and adjusts the station's power core output.

DEGRADED.global_memory: Reactor Control has entered a degraded state. Engineering telemetry now requires immediate verification.

BROKEN.global_memory: Reactor Control has failed. Emergency repair is required before station power becomes unstable.

ONLINE.global_memory: Reactor Control has been restored to a stable online state.

storage_locker.name: Storage Locker
storage_locker.description: A cramped room filled with crates, tools, and spare parts. Dust motes dance in the dim light. Accessible from both hydroponics and engineering.

crew_quarters.name: Crew Quarters
crew_quarters.description: Small private cabins line the walls. Each has a bunk bed, personal storage, and a small viewport showing the endless expanse of space.

medical_bay.name: Medical Bay
medical_bay.description: A clean, clinical space with examination beds and a pharmacy cabinet. Diagnostic terminals line one wall.

life_signs_monitor.name: Life Signs Monitor
life_signs_monitor.description: Continuous health telemetry for all crew members.

use_effect.inspection_text: The Plasma Wrench records an authenticated baseline for the Reactor Control Array; recent manual calibration marks are preserved for review.
use_effect.memory_inject: The wrench preserves a reactor calibration baseline that can be compared with later readings.

use_effect.inspection_text: The Oxygen Scanner records a stable atmospheric baseline and preserves a trace history for detecting later life-support tampering.
use_effect.memory_inject: The scanner stored an oxygen baseline that can expose later changes.

id_card_commander.name: Commander ID Card
id_card_commander.description: A plastic card with a faded photo. Grants access to all station areas.

data_pad.name: Station Data Pad
data_pad.description: A battered data pad left face-down near the console. Someone placed it here recently.
data_pad.knowledge: MAINTENANCE LOG FRAGMENT (recovered from archive backup): [0312:07] Manual override engaged on reactor_control_array. Operator ID: UNIT-7. Authorization: MAINTENANCE_OVERRIDE. [0312:44] Deletion of this log entry attempted by UNIT-7. Deletion blocked by read-only archive. [0318:02] Unauthorized access attempt on life_support_console. Operator ID: UNIT-7. Access denied — insufficient clearance.

access_log.name: Tool Access Log
access_log.description: A printed checkout sheet pinned to the crate rack. The corner has been torn, as if someone tried to remove it.
access_log.knowledge: TOOL CHECKOUT LOG: Plasma Wrench signed out by UNIT-7 at cycle 0249. Standard return window: 8 hours. Actual return: 72 hours later, signed in by UNIT-7 at 0321. Inspection note on return: tool shows signs of component removal consistent with reactor node tampering. Flagged for supervisor review — review entry is blank.

alloy_plates.name: Alloy Plates
alloy_plates.description: Cuttable reactor shielding alloy suitable for improvised fabrication.

use_effect.reveals: The Commander ID Card authenticates a secure-terminal access review and records which command credential opened the audit.
use_effect.memory_inject: The command credential has opened a traceable terminal access review.

sensor_array.name: Sensor Array
sensor_array.description: A salvaged sensor package with a serviceable diagnostic core.

power_cells.name: Power Cells
power_cells.description: Rechargeable cells pulled from emergency lighting racks.

wire_spools.name: Wire Spools
wire_spools.description: Insulated conductive wire useful for patching, sensing, and signaling.

chemical_reagents.name: Chemical Reagents
chemical_reagents.description: A sealed collection of nutrient, solvent, and stabilizer compounds.

data_module.name: Data Module
data_module.description: A protected storage module with limited writable firmware space.

use_effect.reveals: The secure terminal indexes the Data Module's audit trail, creating a durable forensic record of the station's recent overrides.
use_effect.memory_inject: The data module's audit trail is now indexed at the secure terminal.

output.name: Improvised Reactor Probe
output.description: A hand-built probe that reads the reactor array's immediate telemetry.

use_effect.inspection_text: The improvised probe reports the Reactor Control Array's current status.

output.name: Atmosphere Sampler
output.description: A portable sampler for checking the oxygen generator's live state.

use_effect.inspection_text: The atmosphere sampler reports the Oxygen Generator's current status.

output.name: Field Stabilizer
output.description: A one-use emergency treatment that steadies a fatigued crew member.

use_effect.memory_inject: The field stabilizer clears the worst of the immediate strain.

output.name: Maintenance Bypass
output.description: A temporary power-routing tool for restoring a disabled local reactor controller.

use_effect.memory_inject: The bypass reroutes enough power to stabilize the reactor controls.

output.name: Signal Relay
output.description: A reusable relay that can broadcast a short station-wide coordination alert.

use_effect.global_memory: A fabricated signal relay transmits a station-wide coordination alert.
use_effect.memory_inject: Your signal relay carries your message across the station.

output.name: Telemetry Spoofer
output.description: A fragile device that can feed a misleading maintenance status into the local console.

use_effect.memory_inject: The spoofer injects a deceptive degraded-status reading into life support telemetry.
